visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit medical office. A young woman with long dark hair sits opposite a female doctor wearing a white lab coat and a blue surgical mask. They are positioned at a wooden desk with a large mirror between them. Bright white light lines radiate from the center, highlighting the characters. (2) The camera transitions to show a round gold-colored sign for 'View Plastic Surgery' mounted on a purple wall. This is followed by a shot of a 'WHITE BASE' sign on a glass door and then a view into a clean, modern clinic lobby with chairs and a reception desk. (3) A sequence displays various cosmetic product displays, including a purple teddy bear and colorful boxes labeled 'REJURAN.' The camera then pans down a long, white, brightly lit corridor with numbered doors, showing a clean clinical environment. (4) Map interface and Google search results for the clinic are shown on a screen. This is followed by close-up shots of numerous framed certificates, trophies, and awards displayed on purple shelves, indicating professional recognition and safety standards. (5) Back in the consultation room, the woman looks into a hand mirror as the doctor points to specific areas of her face. The doctor uses her hands to demonstrate facial contours while the woman listens attentively, her expression shifting from curious to slightly hesitant. (6) A montage of the treatment process begins. An assistant cleanses the woman's face while she lies on a treatment bed. Then, a white cream is applied to her cheeks and forehead, covered with plastic film for numbing. (7) The doctor, now wearing purple gloves, performs injections on the woman's face. Small droplets of blood are briefly visible on the skin. The woman remains still during the procedure in the brightly lit treatment room. (8) The final phase shows the woman post-treatment, looking into the mirror with a satisfied smile. She later appears in a different setting, speaking directly to the camera, pointing at her facial contours to show the results of the procedure.
